answer: Calibration audits: the network quietly slips known-answer tasks into every grading queue, so each identity's quill leaves a record measured against ground truth. Only identities that score above 90% across 200 hidden tests may bridge earned points into spendable balance. A farmer can't lend one good grader to a nebula of fake accounts, since every clone faces its own unseen tests, so each sybil costs about 200 honest tasks of real inference before any payout.
